summary: The change correctly prefers a failed, timed out or startup failure job over a cancelled sibling while preserving cancellation only reporting, and the regression tests exercise that ordering.

evidence: ops/hosted-autonomy-observation.ts now prefers a failure, timed_out or startup_failure job before any cancelled sibling, so a cancelled maintenance job cannot mask the job that actually failed.
tests/repair/hosted_self_observation_test.ts covers cancelled first ordering for each preferred conclusion and confirms cancellation is still reported only when no failed sibling exists.
This changes the self observation path that produced issue 220 so the run is attributed to the actual failed job rather than the cancelled sibling.
